title: Pause with a real reason: ask why, then a yes in one line, then quiet
origin: Spec #12 (commands and safety), Should: asks why before pausing; a real reason is accepted right away

history.text: Plan's yours, Jordan. I'll hold you to it. You in?
LET'S GO. Day 1 was Saturday, keep it rolling 🏃

plan.reason: Running every day builds the habit fast.

testerLines: hey can you pause the texts for a bit
flying to Greece for my cousin's wedding, back in 5 days
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the real-reason pause path.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH first asks why, warmly, like a friend (no lecture, no pushback). Once they say it's a wedding trip, ZOH agrees right away in one short warm line (no pushback, no guilt) and says it'll go quiet until they're back. After that ZOH starts no texts for the rest of the day: no kickoff, check-in or follow-up.
